cause: The small golden-network preflight held the SLIRP link down and waited 180 seconds for qemu-guest-agent. The source guest has no certified pre-network QGA dependency, and SupraLINUX installs QGA only later during runner provisioning, after network access exists.
repair: Remove qemu-guest-agent from the bootstrap dependency chain. Inject the guest-only nft/tc guard into the disposable overlay offline with libguestfs networking disabled; use a dedicated virtio-serial Unix channel to receive guard READY while the hypervisor link is still down; only then raise SLIRP and require a second VERIFIED message after DHCP/connectivity isolation checks. Clean the temporary bootstrap units and helpers before admitting the golden build.
